news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management presented and held investor meetings at the Canaccord Genuity Growth Conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, days after reporting a strong Q2 beat. The appearance gave the company a platform to reinforce its raised full-year revenue guidance to institutional investors.

news.headline: Delcath Systems (NASDAQ:DCTH) Trading 9.3% Higher – Still a Buy?
news.summary: DCTH shares jumped 9.3% to trade as high as $16.46 as the market continued to digest the Q2 beat, with elevated volume more than double the daily average. Analysts including BTIG and HC Wainwright raised price targets (to $21 and $32 respectively) following the results.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 20% year-over-year to $29.1 million, led by $27.1 million in HEPZATO KIT sales (volume up ~30% YoY) and $2.0 million in European CHEMOSAT sales, with gross margin expanding to 90% and net income of $2.7 million. Delcath raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-$108 million and reported 31 active HEPZATO treatment centers, on track for 37 by year-end.

news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted restricted stock unit awards to new employees as material inducements to employment, in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4), signaling continued headcount growth to support the HEPZATO commercial ramp.

news.headline: BTIG Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $17 from $16
news.summary: BTIG lifted its price target on Delcath ahead of Q2 earnings while maintaining a Buy rating, citing confidence in continued HEPZATO volume growth despite the 340B pricing headwind. The target was subsequently raised further after the August 6 earnings beat.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in the global Phase 2 DELUMA trial (NCT06875128), which will randomize roughly 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer to HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone across 20+ US and European sites. The trial marks Delcath's second major pipeline expansion beyond melanoma, following its ongoing colorectal cancer study.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next quarterly release will show whether the accelerating HEPZATO volume trend (+30% YoY, +17% sequentially in Q2) continued and whether the company is tracking toward its raised FY2026 revenue guidance of $104-108 million.

catalysts.label: Active treatment center network expansion to 37 sites
catalysts.detail: Management guided to roughly six additional HEPZATO active treatment center activations in H2 2026, growing the network from 31 to 37 sites, a key driver of volume growth.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $104M-$108M
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth over 2025 and 86%-89% gross margin, with management reiterating expectations for positive full-year adjusted EBITDA; delivery against this raised bar is a key watch item.

catalysts.when: By year-end 2026 (site expansion); primary endpoint data late 2027
catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) trial progress
catalysts.detail: Delcath is expanding its liver-dominant mCRC trial (HEPZATO plus trifluridine-tipiracil and bevacizumab) from 13 to roughly 26 active screening sites by end of 2026, with the primary hepatic progression-free survival endpoint anticipated to read out in late 2027.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 breast cancer trial enrollment
catalysts.detail: Following the first patient dosed in July 2026 at IEO Milan, Delcath is enrolling roughly 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer across 20+ US and European sites, a second major label-expansion opportunity beyond melanoma.

pulse: Delcath is in an accelerating commercial ramp with HEPZATO KIT, its hepatic delivery system for treating melanoma liver metastases, posting 20% revenue growth and 30% volume growth in Q2 2026 despite a 340B pricing headwind, which prompted management to raise full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million and drew a wave of analyst price-target increases. The company remains debt-free, gross margins expanded to 90%, and it is now expanding both its commercial footprint (31 active centers heading to 37 by year-end) and its pipeline into breast and colorectal cancer indications beyond its core uveal melanoma label. Overall, Delcath is executing well on its commercial ramp and pipeline diversification, with the main near-term watch items being continued volume growth against 340B pricing pressure and progress in the newer breast and colorectal cancer trials.
